title: TikTok Shopping Cart Guide: How to Find, Fix, and Use It
summary: Cannot find your TikTok shopping cart or missing the orange cart icon on your videos? Follow our step-by-step guide to fix cart bugs and buy or sell quickly.
body_markdown:
## Troubleshooting: Why Your TikTok Shopping Cart Isn't Appearing


### Common Reasons for a Missing Orange Cart Icon


A missing icon does not always mean the account is broken. TikTok Shop may not operate in your location, the listing may be unavailable to your account, or the seller may have removed inventory. Other causes include an outdated app, a temporary service issue, age or account restrictions, incomplete Shop setup, or a product still under review. On creator posts, the attachment may be awaiting moderation or commission approval.


### Fix 1: Clearing App Cache and Data


Start with the local app session because stale files can stop current Shop controls from loading. In TikTok, open your profile, select the menu, choose **Settings and privacy** , then open **Free up space** and clear the cache. On Android, system app settings can also clear TikTok’s temporary storage. On iPhone, offload or reinstall the app if in-app clearing fails. Sign in again, test a tagged product, and check whether the icon returns.


### Fix 2: Checking Account Settings and Regional Compliance


Review your account region, age information, language, payment profile, and Shop permissions. Do not use a VPN while testing, since a location mismatch can affect product availability and checkout. Creators should confirm that TikTok Shop requirements, tax, identity, payout, and content policy steps are complete in Seller Center or the applicable creator dashboard. A feature may stay hidden until the account or marketplace clears compliance review.


### Fix 3: Verifying Product Eligibility and Commission Status


If the problem affects one video or listing, inspect that product rather than the entire account. Confirm active inventory, approved images and descriptions, supported shipping destinations, and an affiliate commission rate. A catalog item may be visible yet unavailable to a specific creator because of brand restrictions, category rules, sample requirements, or pending approval. The FastMoss TikTok Data Analytics Platform can show whether the issue is isolated or widespread by reviewing product and creator activity.


### When to Contact TikTok Support


Contact support after updating the app, clearing the cache, checking eligibility, and testing multiple products. Include the video URL, product ID, account region, device model, app version, timestamp, and screenshots of the missing control. State whether the problem affects one listing, every post, or only viewers. This creates a reproducible case instead of a general missing-cart report.


**Creator diagnostic:** TikTok Shop research indicates that video engagement can drop by more than 40 percent when product links fail to appear within the first 60 minutes after posting. Check the attachment promptly, document the delay, and avoid repeated deletion and reposting until the original product status is known.
